root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the scalar `ROLE` branch may execute `entity->roles[entity_role_cnt++] = role`, it must prove `entity_role_cnt < G_N_ELEMENTS(entity->roles)`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable scalar `ROLE` path omits the six-slot bound check that the array path performs. On the witnessed seventh scalar append, `entity_role_cnt` is already 6 while `entity->roles` has only six elements.

nodes.description: At the crashing scalar append, the write index equals the six-element `entity->roles` capacity, so the store targets `entity->roles[6]`, the first out-of-bounds slot named by AddressSanitizer.

edges.relation: The same pre-increment `entity_role_cnt` value observed at the scalar-role guard is the index consumed by the immediately following `entity->roles[entity_role_cnt++]` write.
